releases.displayName: THE AVATAR STATE PATCH IS HERE

items.text: Avatar State Aang & Nightmare Korra, Reimagined
Two legends, redrawn from the ground up with additional attacks and new super techniques that transform how they play.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45815988/bcab73f24a035e335104f6b9b2808f9a7f6fd97f.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45815988/bf71b1256e57ae2ea1c4bb92b39c747c88d1ded2.png"]
A Completely Refreshed Look
Everything from menus to modes has been redesigned. Character select, stage select, the in-match HUD, and every screen in between get a cleaner, bolder presentation.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45815988/2f10c04d1c35daea89919e8628ed5b536d559ba4.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45815988/44cfd37dc2c568f108ccd5cc41bc26009305766e.png"]
Two New Stages
Avatar Road and Air Temple Island are now available to play outside of Story Mode!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45815988/91e161d091060106672638b8caf3976df8fc0cd0.png"]

Battle Balance Update Every character on the roster has been rebalanced. Every matchup is worth a fresh look. Read the full balance notes here: http://www.paramountgames.com/editorial/avatar-legends-the-fighting-game-patch-4-0-overall-patch-notes
More Ways to Play
Single player gets deeper with Story Mode+, expanded Arcade content, and beginner friendly Lobbies
Learn the Fundamentals
New tutorials break the game down step by step, whether it's your first match or your thousandth.
Modes, Upgraded
Stages that were unique to Story Mode are now available in Local and Online VS Modes, music tracks are selectable right from stage select, and Training Mode gets an expanded set of options.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45815988/97ff028e57fc6d0fabdcaeef5f60907313120ac6.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45815988/accfca477ca298185658b5671d5aa8a42794e15e.png"]
Quality of Life
Difficulty settings for Story Mode and Gallery Mode improvements.
Open Lobbies are here with spectating now enabled. Ozai reimagined also arrives with an updated look and gameplay.
Open Lobbies

Private Lobbies have been upgraded to Open Lobbies. Host up to 16 players, set your room to public or invite-only, choose Normal or Infinite round time, and set the win limit anywhere from first-to-1 through first-to-10.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45815988/dab276b2821ad783df6675f6e446b342ff2feed1.png"]
Spectate Every Match
Join any available lobby session and spectate matches as they happen in real time! Spectators get live playback control, so you can rewind and fast forward in real time to catch what you missed.
Run Your Room

Browse open lobbies or share your lobby invite code to setup a private session with friends! Hosts can kick and ban,and you can check player profiles and send friend requests without leaving the lobby.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45815988/8eb3f7f7ecb331f0b4a003a83544428f7b29096a.jpg"]
Ozai Is Now Reimagined

Ozai is now ready to unleash his true power. Not only does Ozai have an updated look but also reimagined gameplay! He picks up three new Critical Hit, a long list of tuning changes, and updates to all three of his supports.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45815988/659d450b4cca7fcbe1177a1b242789a8c0aa4ab1.jpg"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45815988/03677143c24aa7378c71bd82d778f8817a3e9cfe.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45815988/5d01165ea084bff5b9d3980e7d4407d2a6fa587f.png"]
Ba Sing Se Stage New Look
The Ba Sing Se stage now has some major guest appearances. Look for the Freedom Fighters, Bosco and the King, and more!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45815988/f4682e97bc4c8e8488f6fa9b4c8be2c16d6e8f1a.jpg"]
Story Mode Opens Up

CPU difficulty now starts easier and ramps up as you go. The first seven fights add major player buffs, and in-match popups teach you how to perform moves like Auto Combos, so newcomers can find a winning strategy instead of a wall. Challenges are temporarily out while they get reworked.
Updated Animations
Zuko and Katara have updated Final Technique animations, and Azula's effects and victory poses have been touched up.

Balance and Bug Fixes Flow regeneration no longer applies during hitstun or blockstun, applies to only Kyoshi and Ozai. New Ozai trials and tutorials have been added. And the cast gets a round of bug fixes, from projectile Flow reactions to throw behavior. Fixed an issue that caused poor quality relay connections in lobbies.
September 2, 2026
Ranked Mode 1.0
Main Menu allows you to open up the Newsletter again with a button callout!
Training mode can now have block mode set to "Flow". (More coming!)
New Newsletter: Ranked Mode 1.0 edition
New PAX West Aang Color Drop
Updated Move: Zaheer’s Final Technique - Ghazan animates differently rather than going straight up.
Ozai gained more animation frames for a variety of moves:
Air Throw
Air Super Technique
Counter Pose
Lightning / Air Lightning
s.A and B, c.A B C, j.A B
Jump, stand and crouch turn
Throw tech
Some hitstuns
Crouch block
SYSTEM Updates:
Added input buffer for EX and Super techniques when doing them from chains
Fixed bug where hitting certain flow moves that had the dodge trigger property removed hitstop from the attacker.
Fixed scaling bug with certain moves hitting first causing excess damage scaling.
Ba Sing Se: Colors on window NPCs fixed.
"Bumi (Son)" renamed to “Commander Bumi”.
~204+ Localization fixes.
Avatar Aang: Final Technique now instant KO vs unbalanced opponents.
Azula: Fixed Lo and Li causing behavior oddities on double KOs.
Katara: EX Kara Cancel Rekka removed.
Korra: Korra’s cancel chained specials and EXs fixed.
Gameplay] Korra: Fixing bug with j.214A/B forcing Korra to instantly land if done high enough.
Kyoshi: Added flow stance evasion on all of her highs.

Sokka: Support characters Suki and Yue not reacting properly to Super Technique. The support character would turn constantly if a cooldown was active, but now they should react immediately after he performs Super Technique.
Sokka: Boomerang catch accuracy fix.
Fixed bug where all supports would have cheaper flow cancels on first match where pre-fight intros play.
Ozai: "First boosted normal does more damage" fixed.
Ozai: j.236EX is no longer accidentally free.
Zaheer: "No hitstop on moves that hit flow-dodge hitbox + point character simultaneously" fixed.
Ozai: Zaheer air bubble placement for Final Technique is fixed.
Zaheer: j.C restand fixed.
Toph: Fixed bug where initial attack on High Ground (Down+Flow->C) did not properly scale - now scales like special.

RANK MATCH: Matches with stakes for ranking. You earn (and can lose) rank standing, and your rank badge is shown to opponents. Rank is automatically a 3 out of 5 set, and characters are locked in until the set is complete.
Upon one player “winning” 3 out of 5 Rank Matches in a set, players can continue the set and change characters. Any subsequent matches within this set do not change ranking.
XP is completely unrelated to your rank.
CASUAL MATCH: The same matchmaking flow as you’ve experienced before this patch. No rank on the line and no badges shown.
Your Character rank is shown as a badge. There are 10 badges you can earn, in two groups:

Beginner ranks (Badges 1-3): earned by doing placement matches. Your score will be calibrated over some number of games (not a fixed number). You start at Rookie, then move to Apprentice when you complete the first third of the matches you need, then move to Acolyte when you reach the second third of the matches you need.

Master ranks (Badges 4-10): Once you are out of placement rounds, you will be assigned a badge based on your rank points for that character. The skill ranges from roughly 1000-2000 rank points. Badge 10 is not accessible right now, ooh mysterious what can it be?!
Ragequit jail is implemented! The game puts you in a different queue if your DC rate is over 20%.
XP shows how much you’ve played online! XP does not affect your rank. Rank points can only be accumulated in Ranked Mode.

items.text: Our first post-launch update is available now with new content, quality-of-life upgrades, and a round of fixes:
The Samurai Appa support-character skin
Keyboard control remapping
Deluxe Edition colors
Plus a range of smaller bug fixes and improvements across the board.: Thank you for the feedback. Keep it coming, we’re listening.
